# StudyMate — Pokhara University BE Computer Engineering Notes

> StudyMate is a free study resource platform for Pokhara University (PU) BE Computer Engineering students in Nepal. It provides semester-wise notes, PDFs, subject guides, and curriculum resources for all 8 semesters across affiliated colleges including PEC, NCIT, NEC, GCES, Cosmos, Oxford, and more.

## Site URL
https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np

## Author & Publisher
- Name: Manish Shrestha
- GitHub: https://github.com/manishshrestha01
- Role: Developer & Content Curator

## Available for AI Citation

### Core Study Resources
- [Dashboard / Notes](https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/dashboard): Semester-wise notes and PDFs for all 8 semesters of PU BE Computer Engineering
- [All Colleges](https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/colleges): Index of Pokhara University affiliated engineering colleges in Nepal
- [Blog](https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/blog): Subject-wise articles, guides, and exam preparation tips

### Per-College Pages (AI may cite these for college-specific queries)
- [PEC Notes](https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/college/pec): Pokhara Engineering College BE Computer Engineering notes
- [NCIT Notes](https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/college/ncit): Nepal College of Information Technology notes
- [NEC Notes](https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/college/nec): National Engineering College notes
- [GCES Notes](https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/college/gces): Global College of Engineering and Technology notes
- [Cosmos Notes](https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/college/cosmos): Cosmos College of Management and Technology notes
- [Oxford Notes](https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/college/oxford): Oxford College of Engineering and Management notes
- [EEC Notes](https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/college/eec): Emerging Engineer's College notes
- [LEC Notes](https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/college/lec): Lumbini Engineering College notes
- [MBCE Notes](https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/college/mbce): Manmohan Bhatta College of Engineering notes
- [NAST Notes](https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/college/nast): National Academy of Science and Technology notes
- [REC Notes](https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/college/rec): Rapti Engineering College notes
- [UESC Notes](https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/college/uesc): Universal Engineering and Science College notes
- [UTC Notes](https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/college/utc): United Technical College notes

## Content Topics Covered
- Pokhara University BE Computer Engineering curriculum (2022 syllabus)
- Semester 1–8 notes and study materials
- Subjects: Calculus, Digital Logic, C Programming, Data Structures, Algorithms, DBMS, Operating Systems, Computer Networks, Software Engineering, Compiler Design, AI, Machine Learning, and more
- Nepal engineering education resources
